move: dashboard cells pop in staggered, stats count, bars grow, fold out
how: A dark 4x2 bento of five cells (overview text, completion ring, team list, active-user stat, velocity bars) scales in from 0.7 with y 60 and opacity 0, expo.out over 0.9s at 120ms stagger from the start. Labels then lift in, the overview lines rise (power3.out), twelve bar-chart bars grow from scaleY 0 (expo.out, 50ms stagger) at 11%, four avatar rows slide in from x 40, an SVG ring stroke-dashoffset runs 100 to 14 (expo.out 1.6s) and two counters run 0 to 86% and 0 to 12,480 with expo.out over 1.8s from 12%. During the hold a timeline dot travels 550px along its line (power1.inOut, 25-62%) and the bars breathe to new heights and back (sine.inOut yoyo). At 89% the cells shrink to 0.8, lift and fade with power3.in in reverse order.
adapt: Replace the five cell contents, counter targets (data-to), bar heights array, avatar names and accent colours; the grid areas can be rearranged in CSS. Keep the 0.9s expo.out entry at 120ms stagger and the 1.8s expo.out counters.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the grid and cells inside el and sets bar heights from shot data. animate(el, shot, D) returns the same timeline; the counter tweens iterate el.querySelectorAll('.n') and the dot travel distance should be measured from the cell width instead of the fixed 550px.
caveats: from() tweens; use immediateRender:false if built after first paint
ends on an empty stage, restarts with the pop-in
